steps.caption: Choose the updated 'Pune contacts.xlsx' — same name, new content.
It is version 2 of the same source. Uploading the identical file again would change nothing.
Changes summary: companies and people you already had are linked, not duplicated.
Column layout changed: a Budget column was added, and Mobile and Email swapped places.
Columns are matched by header, not position, so the swap breaks nothing.
Rows missing from the new version are reported only — no record is deleted or archived.
Open Technical details for the row-by-row comparison.
Changes vs previous version: changed, added and removed rows, field by field.
Kavita Nair's area went from 15,000 to 18,000 sq ft. The earlier observation is kept.
Values that differ from your records are never overwritten — they are proposed for approval.
All imports lists both versions with their fingerprints.
Source cell links: open a company from the file — Pebblewick Software.
'Source (spreadsheet rows)' shows the file, version, sheet and cell behind each value.
